rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) was injured due to a hazardous condition on the policyholder's premises (icy walkway), which is the textbook definition of a premises liability claim covered under homeowners insurance.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's daughter fell on the policyholder's icy walkway during an ice storm and broke her wrist. Parents are seeking coverage for medical bills. This is a high-severity pediatric injury claim involving premises liability.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped and fell on icy walkway
